refs.finding: MA-crossover and trading-range rules had significant in-sample predictive power on the DJIA 1897-1986 (before costs).
MACD/RSI rules beat buy-and-hold on the FT30 over ~60 years, gross of costs.
After correcting for the universe of rules searched, the best rules' superiority weakens sharply and does not persist post-1986.
Genuine walk-forward MA/momentum timing falls far below in-sample backtests and generally fails to beat buy-and-hold.
After false-discovery control and realistic costs, technical-rule profits vanish and do not persist.
~56/95 surveyed studies found profitability, but flag data-snooping and a clear post-1980s decline in equity-market profitability.

failure_modes: crossover lag giving back gains at reversals

refs.finding: Strong negative short-horizon serial correlation — the reversal these rules target is real in the data.
Weekly contrarian portfolios earn positive abnormal returns, consistent with short-term overreaction/reversal.
RSI overbought/oversold rules beat buy-and-hold on the FT30 in-sample, gross of costs.
Contrarian profits arise substantially from cross-stock lead-lag, so single-name own-reversal is overstated.
Returns switch between a trending and a mean-reverting regime, so reversal pays only in the ranging regime and loses in trends.
Short-term reversal profits concentrate in illiquid high-turnover names and are essentially eliminated by realistic costs.

failure_modes: gets run over in trending regimes (oversold to more oversold)
edge concentrated in illiquid names (limited capacity)

refs.finding: Persistent 1-12 month time-series momentum across 58 futures — the trend that breakout systems exploit.
A simple trend strategy earned positive risk-adjusted returns every decade 1880-2016, strongest in crises.
Channel and dual-MA rules were significantly profitable out-of-sample across 28 commodity futures, net of costs.
Trading-range-breakout rules had in-sample predictive power on the DJIA, before costs.
Correcting for ~7,846 rules searched, the best rules' superiority weakens and fails to persist out-of-sample.
After false-discovery control and realistic costs, no technical rules show persistent profitability.

failure_modes: false breakouts / whipsaw in range-bound markets
edge concentrated in a few trending / high-volatility episodes
parameter sensitivity of the channel/lookback length

refs.finding: Strong negative short-horizon serial correlation — recent winners reverse, so buying up-bars is on the wrong side.
Weekly contrarian (buy losers) earns positive returns — the opposite of a follow-the-bar rule.
Bid-ask bounce mechanically induces spurious negative serial covariance, so much 1-bar dependence is a non-tradable artifact.
Random walk rejected, but the sign of autocorrelation differs between indices and single stocks — predictability is weak and level-dependent.
Small negative daily autocorrelation from pricing errors reversing — any short-horizon signal is dominated by transient noise.
Trading costs on high-turnover return-based strategies consume or exceed gross profits — fatal for a rule that trades nearly every bar.

failure_modes: extreme turnover so transaction costs dominate any gross edge

refs.finding: Once the full universe of candidate rules is priced in, apparent pattern edges weaken sharply and fail out-of-sample.
Microstructure bid-ask bounce can manufacture spurious short-horizon signals that patterns may pick up but cannot trade net of the spread.
Short-horizon predictability is weak and level-dependent, limiting what discrete bar patterns can extract.
After false-discovery control and costs, no technical rules show persistent profitability.

failure_modes: too few and too noisy signals to establish a credible edge
data-snooping over the large space of possible patterns
no documented persistent edge for the class

refs.finding: A survey of 95 studies finds mixed profitability and stresses data-snooping and post-1980s decline.
Aggregating many rules amplifies data-snooping; corrected performance of the best combinations is far weaker.
After false-discovery control and costs, combined technical signals show no persistent profitability.

failure_modes: does not beat its best single component after correction
